text: Only non-empty lists are valid inputs; behaviour on the empty list is unspecified.

phrase: the number of elements that need to be changed
text: The number of positions whose element differs from its mirror element, counting both elements of every mismatched pair (twice the minimum).

The answer counts change operations as defined by 'In one change, you can change one element to any other element' (the two coincide for a minimal set of changes, but the text names elements here and changes there).
Compute and output (e.g. print) the number; the return value is unspecified.

phrase: read the same backwards and forwards
text: Textually: the concatenated decimal digits of the elements form a palindromic string (e.g. [12, 1] reads '121').
The value of another element already present in the array (the minimum count is the same, since a mismatched element can always take its mirror's value).
The answer counts change operations, each of which modifies one element (consistent with counting elements for a minimal set of changes).
